title: Trump faces questions over latest attack on Venezuelan boat
summary: A second US strike on a Venezuelan boat in international waters has raised concern over the legality of the attacks.

title: Japan Pushes Back on US Call for Tariff Hikes Over Russian Oil
summary: Japan’s finance minister pushed back against a US call to ramp up pressure on President Vladimir Putin to end the war in Ukraine by imposing higher tariffs on China and India for importing Russian oil.
